summary: Enova International filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its ODR 2022 Securitization Facility, a revolving receivables facility. The amendment increased commitments to $420M across Class A ($338M) and Class B ($82M) loans, with borrowing rates of CP+2.35% and SOFR+7.50% respectively, and extended the revolving period to June 2028 and maturity to June 2029. The company acted as performance guarantor. No special situation is present; this is a routine refinancing of existing debt. There are no deal terms, strategic intent, or event-driven catalyst. Watch for filing of the credit agreement in the next quarterly report.
